content: To access the main page, click here. Introduction to the Medical Therapy Page The title of the page should follow the format (Disease name) medical therapy, with only the first letter of the title capitalized. The primary objective of this page is to provide a detailed and comprehensive description of the principal medical therapies utilized in the treatment of the specified disease. At the top of the edit box, include the following: {{CMG}}, your name template, and the microchapter navigation template you created. Ensure that you create internal links within WikiDoc by enclosing key terms in brackets. These links should be as specific as possible. For instance, if the text mentions anterior spinal artery syndrome, the link should direct to anterior spinal artery syndrome rather than generic terms like anterior, artery, or syndrome. For further guidance on creating links, click here. Adhere to the formatting and capitalization rules outlined in the provided template. Each subsection should begin with a sentence that includes the name of the disease. Overview The overview section must include the name of the disease in the first sentence. The purpose of this section is to succinctly summarize the medical therapies used to treat the disease in a few sentences. To view an example of an overview section on a medical therapy page, click here. The content of the sentences should be based on the strength of the recommendation and the level of evidence, as outlined in the ACC/AHA Guidelines. Template for First Sentences Examples: If there is no known treatment for the disease: There is no treatment for [disease]; the mainstay of therapy is supportive care. Supportive therapy for [disease] includes [specific interventions]. The majority of cases of [disease] are self-limited and require only supportive care. If the disease constitutes a medical emergency: [Disease] is a medical emergency and requires prompt treatment. If there is a specific preferred modality of medical therapy: The mainstay of treatment for [disease] is [specific therapy]. Additional Sentences The optimal therapy for [disease] depends on the stage at diagnosis. Pediatric preferred regimen example: [Drug name] 50 mg/kg/day PO q8h (maximum, 500 mg per dose). Medical Therapy Provide a detailed description of the key medical therapies used to treat the disease, including their primary mechanisms of action. Consider creating subsections for each therapy discussed. To search for relevant guidelines, refer to the National Guideline Clearinghouse.
